2610.06625.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
2610.06625.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as "System One" models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier's uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI's batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV's probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna's token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B's. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV's only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities.
2610.06625.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）透過生成文本標記來註解和擴展政治文本或構造。一種新型模型，TypeSafe 將其市場化為「系統一」模型，則返回用戶提供的固定答案集中的決策和概率分佈。一個商業模型 JEV 被宣傳為在成本和速度上相較於傳統 LLMs 具有顯著優勢，並且決策更為精確。因此，它可能對尋求快速且具成本效益地註解或擴展大量文本語料的社會科學家來說是有用的，並且能提供分類器不確定性的可靠指標。然而，這些聲明的準確性以及在社會科學基於文本的任務中更廣泛的模型準確性尚未確立。在本文中，我們正是這樣做的，並希望確立 JEV 在社會科學任務中的適用性。我們將 JEV 與已發表研究中的 LLMs 和人類編碼者進行比較，並與當前中階商業 LLM（GPT-6 Luna）和一個開放權重替代品（Qwen3.8-27B）進行比較。我們發現 JEV 在各種任務中與這兩種 LLM 的能力相當或接近。然而，我們發現與 OpenAI 的批量價格相比，JEV 在成本上並沒有優於 GPT-6 Luna。此外，我們發現當每個問題僅詢問一次時，JEV 的概率比 GPT-6 Luna 的標記概率更為精確，但並不總是優於 Qwen3.8-27B。我們得出結論，除非研究人員對速度有需求，否則 JEV 唯一明顯的優勢在於易於解析其底層選擇概率。
2610.06625.author: Matthew DiGiuseppe et.al.
